state.notSending.note: a live monitor action on a campaign that isn't sending; name: the campaign's name; status: draft, approval, approved, scheduled, sending, paused, sent, cancelled or failed

state.is.note: a send that can't start: the campaign is already in this status

state.alreadySent: "{name}" was already sent or cancelled; duplicate it to send it again.

state.notEmail.message: "{name}" isn't an email campaign: send it from its own Review & send.
state.notEmail.note: a text, push or WhatsApp campaign; Review & send is the screen's name

state.mailboxNotHeld.note: mailbox: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or Other (the other mailbox providers)

state.shareNotHeld.message: That provider's share isn't on hold.
state.shareNotHeld.note: a sending provider's share of a campaign's recipients

state.providerNotConnected: That provider isn't connected to this workspace.
state.abDecided: The A/B test of "{name}" is already decided.
problem.pickProviders: Pick the providers to move between.

problem.readinessBlocked.message: Send Readiness is blocked ({reason}), so the send didn't start. Fix the blocking checks on Review & send.
problem.readinessBlocked.note: reason: the blocking check's title, in Send Readiness's words

problem.readinessBlockedAny: Send Readiness is blocked, so the send didn't start. Fix the blocking checks on Review & send.

stream.note: a sending stream's name, in a list of streams

actor.system.note: who paused or started a send when no person did

audience.all.note: the Send details' audience when the campaign goes to every public list; segment names may follow after " + "

via.mailbox.note: how events arrive, in "Events via …"; listed with "SNS" and "Postal webhooks"

via.webhooks.note: provider: a sending provider's short name (Postal)

event.label.message: {kind, select, delivered {delivered} hardBounce {hard bounce} softBounce {soft bounce} deferred {deferred} complaint {complaint} rejected {rejected} openedMachine {opened · machine} openedHuman {opened · human} clickedScanner {clicked · scanner} clicked {clicked} unsubscribed {unsubscribed} other {{raw}}}
event.label.note: a live feed line's word, lowercase as on the boards

event.short.message: {kind, select, delivered {delivered} hardBounce {bounce} softBounce {bounce} deferred {deferred} complaint {complaint} rejected {rejected} openedMachine {open} openedHuman {open} clickedScanner {scanner} clicked {click} unsubscribed {unsubscribed} other {{raw}}}
event.short.note: the same word, short, on phones

event.suppressed.note: after a hard bounce or a complaint in the live feed

event.feedbackLoop.note: where a complaint came from, in the live feed

event.variant.note: an A/B test's variant (A, B or C), after an open in the live feed

fail.noAudience: The campaign has no audience. Pick a list or segment on Review & send, then start it again.
fail.noSender: The campaign has no sender. Pick one in the composer, then start it again.

fail.render.note: error: the template's own error, in English

fail.conditional.message: The email's conditional content can't be decided: {error}
fail.conditional.note: error: what went wrong, in English

fail.noRoute.message: No sending provider is set up for Broadcasts. Add a route in Sending providers › Routing, then start the send again.
fail.noRoute.note: Sending providers › Routing is the screen

fail.routeGone: The Broadcasts route points at a provider that is no longer connected. Fix the route, then start the send again.
note.complaintOutlook: Microsoft's SmartScreen uses complaint rate directly; staying under 0.1% protects placement for every later send.
note.complaintGmail: Gmail filters bulk mail on the spam rate its users report; staying under 0.1% protects placement for every later send.
note.complaintYahoo: Yahoo filters on the complaints its feedback loop reports; staying under 0.1% protects placement for every later send.
note.complaint: Mailbox providers filter on complaint rates; staying under 0.1% protects placement for every later send.
note.bounce: Bounce rates above 2% tell mailbox providers the list is old; providers such as SES review accounts above 5%.
note.deferral: Mailbox providers defer mail they want to slow down; sending slower usually clears it within the hour.

note.warmupShift.message: The {who} warm-up schedule shifts by a day so the IP doesn't miss its ramp.
note.warmupShift.note: who: the held sending provider's short name

cause.staleLead.note: a likely cause of an auto-pause, in bold before its evidence

cause.stale.message: {events} of {sent} {scope, select, campaign {the campaign} other {{who}}} recipients bounced; most hard bounces are unknown mailboxes, which points at an old or unverified list.
cause.stale.note: scope: campaign, mailbox_provider or route; who: the mailbox provider (Outlook, or Other) or the sending provider (SES)

cause.slowingLead: {scope, select, campaign {the campaign} other {{who}}} is slowing the send down.
cause.slowing: {events} of {sent} messages were deferred with temporary errors (such as 421 4.7.0); {scope, select, campaign {the campaign} other {{who}}} accepts mail again at a lower rate.
cause.fullRate: {who} sent at the provider's full rate with 0 deferrals.
cause.deferrals: {deferred} messages were deferred, so {scope, select, campaign {the campaign} other {{who}}} may also be slowing the send down.
cause.importedLead: Imported {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} contacts} other {contacts}} that never engaged.
cause.importedPendingLead: Imported {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} contacts} other {contacts}} with unclear consent.

cause.imported.message: {total} {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} recipients} other {recipients}} came from the {source, select, xlsx {spreadsheet} none {an} other {{sourceName}}} import{importDay, select, none {} other { on {importDay}}} and have never opened. {events} of the {complaints} complaints are from this group.
cause.imported.note: sourceName: the tool the contacts were imported from (Mailchimp, CSV); importDay: the import's day (2 Oct)

cause.importedPending: {total} {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} recipients} other {recipients}} came from the {source, select, xlsx {spreadsheet} none {an} other {{sourceName}}} import{importDay, select, none {} other { on {importDay}}} with "pending" consent and have never opened. {events} of the {complaints} complaints are from this group.

cause.firstSendLead.message: First send to these contacts from {domain}.

cause.firstSend: They last heard from you through {source, select, xlsx {spreadsheet} none {an} other {{sourceName}}}; the new sender domain looks unfamiliar.
cause.neverLead: {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} contacts} other {Contacts}} who never engaged.
cause.never: {never} of the {complaints} complaints came from recipients who have never opened an email from you.
cause.lapsedLead: {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} contacts} other {Contacts}} who stopped opening.

cause.lapsed.message: {total} {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} recipients} other {recipients}} haven't opened in more than 90 days (at risk or sunset). {lapsed} of the {complaints} complaints are from this group.

cause.noGroup: The {complaints} complaints come from across the {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} audience} other {audience}}, not from one import, signup source or engagement tier.

cause.auth.message: They may have been rotated or revoked. Replace them in Sending providers; nothing else will make this share send.

cause.crashed.message: Connections to {host} are refused, which points at the process or the host rather than the API or your account.

cause.networkLead: The network path to {name} is down.
cause.network: Connections fail before {name} answers; check the server's outbound network and DNS.
cause.proxy: 502 from the proxy in front of {name} matches an upstream that is down.
cause.throttling: It answered 429 Too Many Requests; the account's rate or daily quota may be lower than ReputeCast assumed.
cause.down: Its health checks failed; ReputeCast's provider monitor marked it down.
cause.outage: Its API failed every call; check {name}'s status page.

cause.warmupCap.message: Not a quota or rate issue: {sentToday} of today's {cap} warm-up cap used, {perSecondRate} /s.

cause.quota: Not a quota issue: {used} of {max} used.

rec.lower.message: Lower the {who} rate to {lowerRate} /s for the rest of this send.

rec.moveToFlow.message: Move those {exclude} contacts into the "{automation}" automation instead of this broadcast.

rec.excludeImported: Exclude the {exclude} never-engaged {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who}} other {}} imports from the remaining {held}. Expected complaint rate after the change: about {expectedPct}.
rec.excludeNever: Exclude the {exclude} never-engaged {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} recipients} other {recipients}} from the remaining {held}. Expected complaint rate after the change: about {expectedPct}.
rec.excludeLapsed: Exclude the {exclude} at-risk and sunset {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{who} contacts} other {contacts}} from the remaining {held}. Expected complaint rate after the change: about {expectedPct}.

opt.resumeTitle.message: Resume as is{recommended, select, yes { (recommended)} other {}}
opt.resumeTitle.note: a way to continue after an auto-pause, a radio card's title

opt.resumeAction.note: the button's label when this way is picked

opt.resumeAll.message: Send to the {held} remaining recipients. opt.resumeAll.note: a way to continue after a campaign-wide auto-pause; ratePct: the rate that tripped; expect: how many more events that rate brings in the rest; more: yes when it brings any

opt.resumeScoped.message: Send to all {held} remaining {who} recipients. The threshold re-arms from the current counts, so only new {metric, select, complaint {complaints} bounce {bounces} block_bounce {block/policy bounces} unknown_user {unknown users} deferral {deferrals} other {events}} can pause it again.{more, select, yes { At today's {ratePct}, expect about {expect} more.} other {}}
opt.resumeScoped.note: who: a mailbox provider or sending provider

opt.cancelCampaignBody: Skip the {held} remaining recipients. They're marked "not sent" in the report.

opt.changes.message: {combo, select, all {Exclude {exclude} {group, select, imported {never-engaged imports} lapsed {lapsed contacts} other {never-engaged contacts}}, send to {rest} at {changeRate} /s, add the excluded contacts to {automation}.} excludeRate {Exclude {exclude} {group, select, imported {never-engaged imports} lapsed {lapsed contacts} other {never-engaged contacts}}, send to {rest} at {changeRate} /s.} excludeFlow {Exclude {exclude} {group, select, imported {never-engaged imports} lapsed {lapsed contacts} other {never-engaged contacts}}, add the excluded contacts to {automation}.} exclude {Exclude {exclude} {group, select, imported {never-engaged imports} lapsed {lapsed contacts} other {never-engaged contacts}}.} other {Send to {rest} at {changeRate} /s.}}
opt.changes.note: what resuming with changes does; changeRate: messages per second; automation: an automation's name

opt.cancelShare.note: who: a mailbox provider or sending provider; also the button's label

opt.cancelShareBody: Skip the remaining {held} {who} recipients. The rest of the campaign finishes normally.
opt.cancelShareLater: Skip the {remaining} remaining recipients. They're marked "not sent" in the report and can be re-sent later.

opt.retryBody.message: Keep the {remaining} recipients on {who}. {seed, select, yes {ReputeCast sends 1 test message to a seed inbox every 60 s} other {ReputeCast sends 1 of them every 60 s as a test}}; the share resumes by itself after 3 successes in a row. If {who} is still down after 15 min, you're asked again.
opt.retryBody.note: who: a sending provider's short name; seed: whether the workspace has a connected seed inbox

opt.moveTitle.note: who, target: sending providers' short names

opt.moveBody: {remaining} recipients join the {target} queue now. The {sent} already sent via {who} keep their tracking.

risk.high.note: the reputation risk of moving a share to another provider

probe.failing.note: a line of the outage log, after the provider's own errors

errorKind.message: {kind, select, auth {rejected credentials} connection {connection errors} throttling {throttling errors} other {API errors}}
errorKind.note: what a sending provider returned, in "Postal returned connection errors for 3 minutes"

notify.heldSummary.note: reason: the blocking check's title, in Send Readiness's words

audit.inDoubtResent: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} in doubt sent again
audit.inDoubtLeftOut: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} in doubt left out

opt.leaveOutAction: Leave {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} out

cause.identityLead.message: {name} refused the sender{domain, select, none {} other { of {domain}}}.
cause.identityLead.note: name: the sending provider's name; domain: the sender's domain

cause.identity: The From address{sender, select, none {} other { {sender}}} isn't verified with {name}, so every message would be refused. Verify it in Sending providers or with {name}, then retry; nothing was marked failed.

cause.apiErrors.message: {errorPct} of its calls failed in the last 3 minutes, over this send's {limitPct} limit.

cause.throttledLong: It kept answering that the account sends too fast for 3 minutes, even at half the rate; its rate or daily quota may be lower than ReputeCast assumed.

cause.retriedLead.note: a likely cause's bold lead: the share was retried and still fails

cause.retried: {who} still didn't take the test message ReputeCast sent every 60 s, so you're asked again.

notify.askAgainBody.message: {provider} still isn't taking mail after 15 minutes of retrying. Its share ({remaining, number} recipients) is still held; the rest keeps sending.

audit.shareRetried.message: Retrying {who}: 1 test message every 60 s{seed, select, yes { to a seed inbox} other {}}, resumes after 3 in a row, asks again after 15 minutes

audit.shareProbed.message: {who} took {count} test messages in a row; its share resumed by itself

check.domain.note: a check ReputeCast ran on a move's target; domain: the sender's domain, target: a sending provider's short name

check.domainUnknown: ReputeCast can't tell whether {domain} is verified on {target}

check.quota.message: {free} of {max} {kind, select, monthly_plan {monthly} other {daily}} quota free after the move

check.warming: {target} is warming up: today's cap may hold part of the share
check.abHoldouts: A/B holdouts stay held until the winner
check.canaryHoldouts: Recipients waiting for the canary stay held until it passes

state.nothingTripped: Nothing tripped on "{name}": there's no limit to raise.

rec.watchSuppressed: The contacts who complained are on the suppression list already.
rec.watchNext: Before the next send, look at who complained: a recent import, or contacts who haven't opened in months, are the usual source.

opt.acknowledge.note: a button: marks an alert as read

notify.watchTitle.note: name: the campaign's name in quotes

notify.watchBody: {scope, select, mailbox_provider {{mailbox} complaints reached {valuePct} (limit {limitPct})} other {Complaints reached {valuePct} (limit {limitPct})}} after the send ended. Nothing is sending; check who complained before the next send.

rec.block_bounce: Block and policy bounces mean the mailbox provider is refusing mail from this sender: check the sender's authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and reputation before sending more.
rec.unknown_user: Many unknown users point to an old or bought list: check where these contacts came from, and verify the list before the next send.
rec.deferral: The mailbox provider is asking you to slow down: the lower rate stays for the rest of this send, and the send pauses that mailbox provider if deferrals reach the next level.
rec.complaint: Look at who complained before the next send: a recent import, or contacts who haven't opened in months, are the usual source.
opt.acknowledgeNotice: Marks the notice as read. {action, select, slowed {The lower rate stays for the rest of the send; change it in Adjust rates.} other {The send keeps going.}}

notify.typedTitle.note: name: the campaign's name in quotes
